content:
I'm very excited to announce the arrival of the v4.9.0 release of Lean!

The headline announcement is the arrival of incremental tactic compilation.
There's a substantial list of improvements, affecting tactics, elaborations, and the standard library, which you can read about in the release notes.

We encourage everyone using previous stable releases to update their repositories to v4.9.0.

Batteries, Aesop, ProofWidgets, and Mathlib are all now available for v4.9.0, as well as lean4checker and lean-repl.

  • the stable branch on each repository has been updated to use v4.9.0
  • there is a v4.9.0 tag in each repository if you would like to pin to a commit using this toolchain.

Some users upgrading from earlier versions are seeing the message:

info: proofwidgets: wanted prebuilt release, but no tag found for revision

If you see this, please run rm -rf .lake and try again. We will try to avoid this happening in future!
The release blog post is now available at https://lean-lang.org/blog/2024-7-1-lean-490/!
